name: ClassiCube
description:
ClassiCube is a custom, lightweight Minecraft Classic and ClassiCube client written in pure C from scratch. Highly optimized to run on virtually any hardware, it provides an authentic creative sandbox experience with enhanced features.

Features:
- Written in pure C with minimal system requirements and rapid startup times
- Full support for singleplayer creative building and multiplayer server joining
- Custom block support, texture packs, player skins, and environmental effects
- Built-in map generator and support for classic .dat, .cw, and .lvl formats
- Smooth camera controls, adjustable field of view, and customizable key bindings
